# ProjectHub

> ProjectHub is a community platform where student developers and software engineers showcase their projects and receive structured peer feedback through code, UI, and functionality reviews.

## Core Features
- Project Showcase: Share web apps, mobile apps, CLI tools, APIs, AI/ML models, and games.
- Structured Peer Reviews: Ratings and constructive feedback across Functionality, UI Design, and Code Quality.
- Developer Dashboards & Profiles: Track submitted projects, feedback scores, and peer contributions.

## Important Links
- [Explore Projects](https://projecthub.com/projects): Browse student and open-source project submissions.
- [Submit Project](https://projecthub.com/projects/submit): Submit a project for peer review.
- [Terms of Service](https://projecthub.com/terms): Platform usage guidelines.
- [Privacy Policy](https://projecthub.com/privacy): Data privacy commitments.
